kind.value: Hosted scheduler with bulk scheduling, RSS automation and post recycling

hosting.value: Hosted (no self-host option on its pricing page)

pricingModel.value: Per social account per month, plus optional extra members; every 10th account and every 10th member is free

freeOption.value: Free plan: 3 social accounts (X excluded), 10 scheduled posts per account, 1 user

trial.value: 7-day trial of Professional, 14-day trial of Business. A credit card or PayPal account is required for the free trial

entryPaid.value: Professional, $5/month for 1 account on monthly billing

plans.value: Professional from $5 and Business from $10 a month for 1 account; extra members $2 each on Professional and $3 on Business (pricing calculator, monthly billing); Enterprise by quote

3.note: Free plan (no X, 10 scheduled posts per account), or Professional

networks.value: 13: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X (paid plans only), Threads, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Mastodon, Google Business Profile, YouTube, Telegram, Bluesky and WordPress

api.value: Publer API on Business and Enterprise for eligible customers; no public API open to every plan

mcp.value: MCP server on Business and Enterprise for eligible customers

ai.value: AI Assist, with unlimited prompts on Business

teams.value: Extra members on paid plans; advanced collaboration and approval workflows on Business
